title: Cryo-EM structures of human ABCA7 provide insights into its phospholipid translocation mechanisms.
authors: Le, Le Thi My; Thompson, James Robert; Dehghani-Ghahnaviyeh, Sepehr; Pant, Shashank; Dang, Phuoc Xuan; French, Jarrod Bradley; Kanikeyo, Takahisa; Tajkhorshid, Emad; Alam, Amer
one_liner_zh: 该文研究人ABCA7磷脂转运蛋白的冷冻电镜结构与分子动力学模拟，对象为脂质转运而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: Phospholipid extrusion by ABC subfamily A (ABCA) exporters is central to cellular physiology, although the specifics of the underlying substrate interactions and transport mechanisms remain poorly resolved at the molecular level. Here we report cryo-EM structures of lipid-embedded human ABCA7 in an open state and in a nucleotide-bound, closed state at resolutions between 3.6 and 4.0 A. The former reveals an ordered patch of bilayer lipids traversing the transmembrane domain (TMD), while the latter reveals a lipid-free, closed TMD with a small extracellular opening. These structures offer a structural framework for both substrate entry and exit from the ABCA7 TMD and highlight conserved rigid-body motions that underlie the associated conformational transitions. Combined with functional analysis and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, our data also shed light on lipid partitioning into the ABCA7 TMD and localized membrane perturbations that underlie ABCA7 function and have broader implications for other ABCA family transporters.
abstract_zh: ABC亚家族A（ABCA）外排蛋白介导的磷脂挤出对细胞生理至关重要，尽管其底物相互作用和转运机制的具体细节在分子水平上仍未得到充分解析。在此，我们报道了脂质嵌入的人源ABCA7在开放状态和核苷酸结合的封闭状态下的冷冻电镜结构，分辨率介于3.6至4.0 Å之间。前者揭示了跨膜结构域（TMD）中一个有序的双层脂质斑块，而后者则揭示了一个无脂质、封闭的TMD，并带有一个小的胞外开口。这些结构为ABCA7 TMD的底物进入和退出提供了结构框架，并突显了支撑相关构象转变的保守刚体运动。结合功能分析和分子动力学（MD）模拟，我们的数据还揭示了脂质在ABCA7 TMD中的分配以及局部膜扰动，这些是ABCA7功能的基础，并对其他ABCA家族转运蛋白具有更广泛的意义。
